title: Longest Substring Without Repeating Characters
statement: Given a string s, return the length of the longest substring that contains no repeated characters.

examples.explanation: "abc" is the longest substring with all distinct characters.
"wke" works. "pwke" is a subsequence, not a substring.

constraints: s consists of English letters, digits, symbols and spaces
edgeCases: repeat jumps the left pointer backward if done wrong: "abba"
keyInsights: Keep a window [left, right] with no duplicates
Store each character's last index; on a repeat, move left to max(left, lastIndex + 1) so it never moves backward
hintLadder: Try tracing your approach on s = "abba". What does your left boundary do at the final 'a'?
Instead of checking every substring, can you keep a window that always has distinct characters and slide it?
Track each character's most recent index. When you see a repeat inside the window, jump left to just past that index, but never move left backward.
